ui_type: Premium beverage product landing page / hero section

overall_design.description: A modern, high-impact landing page for an energy drink brand. The composition is centered around a large product can, with oversized typography in the background, a vivid lime-green gradient background, minimal navigation, product information, size selectors, and subtle navigation controls.
overall_design.primary_goal: Immediately draw attention to the beverage can while communicating the product category, flavor, brand identity, and available sizes.
overall_design.composition_principle: The product can is the dominant foreground element. Oversized MONSTER typography sits behind it and creates depth. Supporting content is positioned in the lower-left area, while controls occupy the top navigation and right/lower portions.

background.description: Bright lime/yellow-green gradient covering the entire viewport.
background.visual_effect: Fresh, energetic and strongly associated with lime flavor and the green Monster visual identity.

primary_text.usage: Large MONSTER background lettering and some dark UI elements.

light_text.usage: Navigation, supporting copy, flavor title, buttons, controls and the light portion of the oversized logo typography.

accent.usage: Green brand elements and visual integration with the can.

notification_red.usage: Small notification badge on the shopping/bag icon.

secondary_gray.usage: Subtle secondary UI elements and low-emphasis text.

brand.description: Simple white wordmark without additional graphical treatment.

background_typography.purpose: Large decorative brand typography behind the product.

visual_treatment.description: The word MONSTER spans almost the entire horizontal viewport and is partially hidden by the product can.
visual_treatment.masking: The can visually occludes the middle of the word, creating a layered 3D composition.
visual_treatment.blend_effect: Dark letters integrate strongly with the background while the right letters contrast against the green.

background_typography.implementation_hint: Render the typography as an absolutely positioned oversized heading behind the product. Use a horizontal gradient or separate spans to transition from black/dark green on the left to off-white on the right.

hero_product.orientation: Front-facing vertical can with a very slight realistic perspective/curvature.

appearance.flavor_label: green ZERO SUGAR band near lower section
appearance.lighting: Realistic product photography with subtle highlights and reflections along the aluminum edges.

hero_product.recommended_implementation: Use a transparent-background product image or isolated PNG/WebP positioned absolutely over the background typography. Avoid generating the can using CSS.

description.text: Discover a world of vibrant flavors with our premium juice selection. At fresh & juicy, we believe in the power of nature's finest ingredients to bring you

interaction.hover: slightly darken background or increase shadow

interaction.active_state: white filled circle with dark text
interaction.inactive_state: semi-transparent dark-green circle with white text

scroll_control.purpose: Indicates that the page continues vertically and encourages scrolling.

interaction.hover: increase border opacity and slightly scale the circle

spacing_system.general: Generous whitespace with strong separation between navigation, hero content and controls.
spacing_system.bottom_controls: kept close to bottom edge while maintaining safe margin

typography.display_font_characteristics: Extremely bold, geometric, compact and wide.
typography.title_font_characteristics: Light rounded/geometric sans-serif with a futuristic beverage-brand feel.

desktop.description: Maintain the current composition with the product centered and large typography extending behind it.

recommended_changes: Reduce oversized MONSTER typography by approximately 20-30%.
Collapse navigation into a hamburger menu.
Move account and shopping icons to the right side.
Scale the product can to approximately 45-55% of viewport width.
Move product lower or center vertically.
Reduce the background MONSTER typography significantly or crop it intentionally.
Move the flavor description below the product.
Move size selector closer to the product.
Keep carousel controls visible near the bottom.
Reduce or hide the Scroll Down indicator if vertical space is limited.

product.behavior: Hero product can change based on carousel navigation or selected flavor/size.

size_selector.behavior: Selecting a size changes active visual state and potentially updates the displayed product or product metadata.

scroll.behavior: Smooth-scroll to the next page section.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Largest foreground object and primary conversion/product recognition element.
Strong brand recognition and visual framing.
Provides site-level navigation without competing with the hero.
Navigation affordances with intentionally low visual weight.

recommended_css.root: position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 100vh; overflow: hidden;

important: Use absolute positioning for the hero composition on desktop.
Use CSS transitions for interactive controls.
Avoid excessive shadows or decorative elements.
Maintain the strong lime-green color field.
Use overflow:hidden to prevent oversized typography from creating horizontal scrolling.

requirements: All icons should have accessible labels.
Size selector buttons should expose their current selected state.
Carousel controls should have aria-label values such as Previous product and Next product.
Scroll Down control should be keyboard accessible.
Navigation links should have sufficient focus states.
Text should remain readable against the lime background.
Do not rely exclusively on color to communicate the active size.

reconstruction_priority: 2. Add oversized MONSTER typography behind the hero.
3. Place the product can precisely in the center foreground.
5. Add the lower-left Cheeky lime content.
8. Add the bottom-right Scroll Down control.
10. Add hover, focus, carousel and selection interactions.
llm_instruction: When reconstructing this UI, prioritize visual similarity over generic landing-page conventions. The central product can must remain the dominant focal point, the oversized MONSTER word must sit behind it, and the lime-green background must occupy the entire viewport. Keep the interface intentionally sparse, with small navigation typography and subtle controls. Do not add sections, cards, shadows, gradients, decorative illustrations or UI components that are not represented in the reference.
